title: T-REGS: Minimum Spanning Tree Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning

layout.note: A wide left panel holds two parallel left-to-right view branches that converge on a sphere, with a three-row loss legend underneath; a thin vertical rule then separates a smaller right panel with the result sphere. Content stops short of the right edge of the canvas.

lesson: Key each loss term by a distinct line or arrowhead style (gradient line = align, bow-tie = repel, dotted = constrain) drawn identically on the embedding picture and in the legend, with the formula term coloured by the view it acts on; repeat the same space at the end state beside it.
